areas.title: Strategy Builder
areas.lead: Search thousands of rule combinations on the market you pick, with the costs and rules you set.
areas.alt: Builder running a search on Coinbase SOL/USD hourly bars: 29,128 strategies tried, none passed the filters
areas.caption: A search on Coinbase SOL/USD, 1 hour. It tried 29,128 strategies and none passed.
items: Genetic, random or sequential search over the rule space, with progress you can watch as it runs.
Rule parts for conditions and price levels, built on the app's own indicator math.
Your own trading rules, costs and money management on each step, with a reset to default for any part.
Strategy templates and build recipes to start from, with a template's rules shown in plain lines before you use it.
Crypto markets get sensible starting exits and costs, and the app tells you what it changed.
Saved research ideas and candidates, and a retest of any strategy with its saved settings.

areas.title: Workflows and robustness checks
areas.lead: Put a strategy through ordered steps, unattended, and see why strategies drop out.
areas.alt: A twelve-step Workflow on Dow Jones 4-hour bars: build, out-of-sample, other markets, timeframes, slippage and Monte Carlo
areas.caption: A twelve-step Workflow on Dow Jones, 4 hour.
items: Ordered steps that run on their own: create, edit, save and reopen a workflow.
A library of ready-made validation workflows and strategy recipes, with search by market and timeframe.
Robustness checks on your results: out-of-sample periods, other markets, higher and lower timeframes, slippage and Monte Carlo.
Walk-forward windows, with a recompute when you change them.
Move a copy of a workflow to your saved market in one click. Each step keeps its own timeframe where the bars allow, and tells you when it can't.

areas.title: Results
areas.lead: See how a strategy really traded, with a plain verdict that says so when it's weak.
areas.alt: A Results page on Coinbase BTC/USD daily bars, graded D: Weak, don't trade it as it is
areas.caption: A verdict on Coinbase BTC/USD, daily: graded D, weak, only 12 trades.
items: One verdict for a strategy, with the reasons behind it.
Summary, trades, equity, results by period and by market, and trade excursions.
A trade list with position value, P/L %, run-up and drawdown, a column chooser and CSV.
Monte Carlo tests and walk-forward results on a strategy's trades.
Prop-firm challenge and funded-phase simulators, with rules and payouts per symbol.
Compare two runs side by side, and analysis tools for drawdown, edge decay and news impact.
Show a strategy on its chart, with where each entry and exit rule was true and why it traded or didn't.
The strategy written as code in EasyLanguage, MetaTrader, Pine or Python.

areas.title: Portfolio
areas.lead: Combine your saved strategies and see their results together.
items: Auto build: build portfolios from your saved strategies, and send strategies straight from Results.
Compose: pick strategies yourself, with a weight for each, and see the combined results.

areas.title: Charts
areas.lead: A full charting workspace on real market data, with indicators, drawings and your own Pine scripts.
areas.alt: A TPO market profile on Coinbase BTC/USD hourly bars with volume below
areas.caption: TPO market profile on Coinbase BTC/USD, 1 hour.
items: Chart types: bars, candles, hollow candles, volume candles, line, line with markers, step line, area, HLC area, baseline, columns, high-low, Heikin Ashi, Renko, line break, Kagi and range.
One grouped indicator list: TradingView's built-ins at their defaults, the Builder's own indicators, patterns and profiles, and your own.
1,014 open-source community indicators in the same list, by category and search. Each runs on the chart, shows its author and licence, and opens its code as a copy.
Drawings: trend line, ray, extended line, rectangle, horizontal line and ray.
VWAP with bands, anchored, rolling and from earnings dates; sessions, killzones and opening range breakouts in New York time; a smart-money study.
Machine-learning buy and sell signals with a read-out of how they would have done on the visible bars.
Your own Pine v5 or v6 indicators and strategies run on the chart, with a Strategy Tester. Anything that can't run is listed by line.
Alerts on price, values, indicator lines and drawings, with notices and sounds.
Bar Replay, saved views, watchlists, compare charts, and up to 16 charts at once on a paid plan.

areas.title: Order flow and profiles
areas.lead: See what traded inside each bar, recorded from the exchange's public feed.
areas.alt: A footprint chart on Coinbase BTC/USD 5-minute bars with delta and volume in each cell, and a stacked imbalance alert
areas.caption: Footprint on Coinbase BTC/USD, 5 minutes, with a stacked imbalance alert.
items: Footprint with per-bar delta and volume, value area, stacked imbalance and row size in ticks.
TPO market profile, with letters, colours by time, volume, trades or delta, and trading hours.
Volume profile: fixed range, session and periodic, with value area and point of control.
Measured delta, cumulative delta, trade counts, volume tails and bar statistics.
An order book heatmap: resting bids and offers over time under the candles, from Kraken or Coinbase, with the largest walls named.
Gamma exposure by strike, drawn from an option chain file you import.

areas.title: Apollo assistant
areas.lead: An assistant beside your work that turns an idea into a strategy you can test. You confirm every change.
areas.alt: The Apollo panel beside a BTC/USD chart
areas.caption: Apollo in a panel beside a BTC/USD chart.
items: Describe an idea in plain words and get a Builder rule part, or a Pine script that's checked before you see it.
It fills in Builder settings for you to review, and asks before it compiles or starts a run.
It recommends a validation workflow for your market and timeframe, and reads your strategy's results with you: the same figures and trades you see.
It proposes one chart change at a time, shown as a card you apply yourself.
It writes custom indicators for your charts, and does the maths with 25 built-in finance methods.
Attach a trade log, a PDF or a chart picture. Your chats are saved and can be exported.
Web search runs only after you approve each one.
Apollo never sends live broker orders. It runs on Apollo credits, included with each paid plan.

areas.title: Models
areas.lead: Machine-learning research on your saved markets or a strategy's trades, judged on data held out from the fit.
items: Studies with purged cross-validation, the deflated Sharpe ratio and triple-barrier labels.
Your chart indicators as features, or a strategy's own trades as the data.
Held-out forecasts shown on the chart, and a route from a model to a Builder strategy and a Library validation.
A sample study with clearly labelled made-up trades, so you can learn the page before using your own data.

areas.title: Journal
areas.lead: Review executions, research results, routines and decisions in one place, kept on your PC.
areas.alt: The Journal's trade calendar and daily note
areas.caption: The Journal's calendar and daily note.
items: Trades, a calendar with daily notes, reports, a notebook, playbooks, routines and prop-firm tracking.
Import statements from many broker file formats.
Attach files to notes, use note templates, or draft a note with Apollo.

areas.title: Market data and import
areas.lead: Free exchange data with no exchange account, or your own files, checked row by row.
items: Coinbase and Kraken: free public history and live prices with no exchange account, at any chart timeframe; Builder takes M2 to D5.
Yahoo daily bars, free.
Your own price files: CSV in common layouts and TradingView's chart export, checked row by row.
MetaTrader 5 history and quotes from your own terminal.
Option chain files with open interest, one per underlying.
A readiness check on your saved data, and saved history kept in your data folder.

areas.title: Exports
areas.lead: Take a strategy to your platform, or get a clear reason why it can't match.
items: TradingView: retest a strategy on TradingView's bar-close timing, then export it as Pine. It refuses what can't match, with the reason.
MetaTrader 5: our own indicators, for use in experts.
Trades as CSV or Excel, charts as PNG, a printable report and prop-firm results from Results.
Chart data and chart images from any chart.

areas.title: Paper trading
areas.lead: Practice on any chart without risking money, on live prices where the market has a live feed.
areas.alt: A paper order ticket and trade history on Coinbase BTC/USD hourly bars
areas.caption: A paper trade on live Coinbase BTC/USD prices.
items: Our own order simulator on every chart and market, with commission, leverage and shorting.
Buy and sell on the chart, with order and position lines, take profit and stop loss, and a mark on the bar for each fill.
An account panel with positions, orders, order history, balance history, activity, trades and analytics, plus CSV.
Practice orders on saved bars in Bar Replay.

areas.title: Connect your broker
areas.how: You sign in with your broker in your own browser, and your password never goes into TraderCockpit.

areas.title: Save and restore
areas.lead: Your work stays on your PC, and you can back it up.
items: Strategies, results, charts and data are saved in your own data folder.
Copy your data folder while the app is closed to back it up, and copy it back to restore.

plans.name: Free
plans.summary: Charts and paper trading, after a free sign-in. No payment.
included: Charts with live prices from the free sources
Unlimited paper trading on live prices
Reading Results and chart layouts you saved on a paid plan (read only)

plans.name: Core
plans.summary: Everything, for one job at a time.

plans.name: Trader
plans.summary: Everything, with more Apollo credits and more jobs at once.

plans.name: Apollo Pro
plans.summary: Everything, with the most Apollo credits and jobs at once.
